outcome_label: Completed under moderate pressure — cooperation held
outcome_detail: This structured task-focused environment run (tension team) reached 100% completion in 16 steps. Stress reached moderate levels with little to no conflict. Agents exchanged 4 pieces of information. Outcome: Completed under moderate pressure — cooperation held. This matches the Tension Team preset. Stress rose while the active blocker remained unresolved, and challenge events showed friction under pressure, but cooperation still outweighed conflict.
